summary: First-finish latency test of Pocket Anchor. Seeded a MongoDB test user + session for ayesha.pocketagency@gmail.com and validated public + authenticated flows across landing, safety, anchor-public, dashboard, and health. AI SSE streaming (comfort + survivor) returns chunked tokens correctly. All three critical pillars (Sanctuary, Nomadic Health, Survivor) are reachable and rendering.
passed: GET /api/auth/me (Bearer seeded token) returns test user with sanctuary_slug='ayesha'
POST /api/hope/ayesha (public, kind=text) created a hope reason id
GET /api/hope (auth) returns 200 array; GET /api/hope/emergency returns favourites/recent
POST /api/ai/chat mode=comfort streams SSE 'data:' chunks then [DONE]
POST /api/ai/chat mode=survivor streams SSE including 988/DV hotline copy
Landing /: mood-pulse-orb + get-started-btn + safety-cta present; headline 'Support that doesn’t ask for an answer' rendered (see landing screenshot)
Safety /safety public: safety-tab-resources, safety-tab-navigator visible, 988 + 1-800-799-7233 rendered, quick-exit-floating-btn visible
Escape x 2 within 700ms triggers decoy-weather-screen (Morning Weather 68°F) and decoy-exit-btn returns to app
Survivor Navigator tab renders chat-input-textarea, chat-send-btn, chat-purge-instant-btn

Anchor public /with/ayesha: anchor-public-container, reason-textarea, supporter-name-input, submit-reason-btn, kindness-counter all present; submitted reason 'You matter to us, keep going.' shows on Wall of Hope

Seeded /dashboard renders Mood Pulse card (Grounded/Hopeful/Struggling), Anchor Link (anchor-hope.preview.emergentagent.com/with/ayesha), Break Glass Archive, Wall of Hope + Journal + Breathing tabs, Quick Exit dock
/dashboard/health: health-tab-clinics active, search-clinic-input, clinic-card-item, clinic-filter-emergency visible; clinics list populated

failed.issue: Review requested POST /api/hope/anchor-hope but actual route is POST /api/hope/{slug} (e.g. /api/hope/ayesha). Using literal 'anchor-hope' returns {detail:'Sanctuary not found'} which is correct behaviour.

data-testid add-medical-record-btn and med-label-input were not found on /dashboard/health default view. They likely live under the 'Medical Vault' sub-tab (default is 'Spatial Health Guide'). Not verified on that sub-tab in this iteration.
failed.evidence: Screenshot shows Spatial Health Guide active with Medical Vault + Doctor Network tabs; testids only asserted on default tab.

failed.issue: 401 on /api/auth/me on public pages before cookie set (expected; AuthContext calls /auth/me). Cosmetic only.
failed.evidence: console error 401 on landing/safety/anchor-public before login

action_items: None blocking. Optionally suppress /auth/me 401 noise on public routes (already gated when hash has session_id, but not on cold /safety visit).
Consider aliasing POST /api/hope/anchor-hope to the current /api/hope/{slug} if the review spec expected that literal path; otherwise update spec wording.
